The '''Centares system''' was the last [[Star system/Legends|system]] on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] before entering the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], and it contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Centares/Legends|Centares]].<ref name="TEA" />
